mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS source_id, s.source_channel, s.data_environment, c.function_module, s.province_code, s.city_code, c.masking_status, c.is_deleted AS deleted, COALESCE(ai.tenant_key, 'DEFAULT') AS tenant_key FROM t_feedback_source s INNER JOIN t_feedback_content c ON c.source_id = s.id LEFT JOIN t_feedback_primary_problem_fact f ON f.feedback_source_id = s.id LEFT JOIN t_application_identity ai ON ai.id = f.application_identity_id WHERE s.id = #{sourceId}
